block.heading: Season blocks
block.name: Block name
block.liveLinkNote: The block uses the package template directly; edits to the template appear in linked block details.

archive.title: Archive package
archive.confirm: Archive “{{name}}”? It will remain visible to linked blocks.

compare.title: Compare packages
compare.priceNote: Enter an approved price per person for each option. Taxes, fees and profit are not calculated. A cost draft only: no sale price and no new booking assignments. No taxes, fees or profit are added.

editor.intro: Build the program, stay periods and transport, then calculate bed costs including taxes and fees.
editor.confirmLegacy: I have reviewed the migrated program and previous data
editor.bedsNote: Choose double, triple or quadruple rooms. Each room has one bed per person.
editor.removeStayConfirm: This stay is used in occupancy options. Remove it and clear its selections? The affected options will require review.
editor.servicesNote: Choose intercity or holy-sites transport, then its permitted mode and service details.
editor.approvedNote: Enter an approved price per person for each option. Taxes, fees and profit are not calculated.
editor.costNote: Bed-night prices include additive taxes and fees, then multiply by total stay nights. This remains a cost draft; profit is not included and new assignments are unavailable.
editor.noOptions: Add an option and choose people per room for each stay, for example two in Makkah and four in Madinah.
editor.manualApproval: Records the source of approval manually; this is not an approval workflow.
editor.notReady: Not available for new assignments yet
editor.taxCaveat: This total is not a final tax-inclusive cost: some items exclude tax or have unspecified tax treatment.
editor.legacyPrice: Previous price for review only: {{amount}} {{currency}}. It is not an approved price for any occupancy option.
editor.unsaved: Your changes have not been saved. Leave this page?
editor.sessionOnly: Changes are in this session only. Local storage failed; do not close the page.
editor.correctErrors: Review the following fields before saving
editor.ready: All required information is complete. You can save this package as available.
editor.availabilityHint: To offer an approved-price package, complete the program, stays, room options, prices, tax treatment and approval.

missing.general: Complete the general details, capacity and program dates within the season.
missing.stays: Complete the hotels, cities, all stay periods and room occupancies.
missing.options: Name the options and select an enabled occupancy for every stay.
missing.costOnly: Cost drafts cannot be made available.
missing.prices: Complete every approved price and specify tax treatment.
missing.approval: Record who approved the prices and the approval date.
missing.legacyReview: Review and confirm the migrated package data.
missing.services: Choose the transport type and mode and complete added transport descriptions.

warnings.overlap: Some stays overlap. Review the contracts and dates; overlapping stays are allowed.
warnings.beds: The allocated beds differ from capacity in some stays.
warnings.seasonRange: Retained dates are outside this season. Review and update them before saving.

validation.dateRange: The end date must follow the start date (stays need at least one night).
validation.stayOutside: Stay dates must fall inside the program period.
validation.duplicateIds: Duplicate identifiers or occupancies were found.
validation.invalidSelection: Review the occupancy or cost scope selection.
validation.notReady: Complete the requirements before making the package available.
validation.required: A package name is required to save a draft.
validation.unsafe: Remove unsupported content from text fields.
validation.seasonRange: Allowed dates are 8 April through 5 June 2027.
validation.periodOverlap: Each period must start on or after the previous checkout.
validation.invalidTransport: This transport mode is not permitted for the selected type.
validation.periodLimit: A stay can have at most 3 periods. Reduce extra periods before saving.

editor.confirmOption: I reviewed this option after the stay changes
editor.removeOptionConfirm: Costs scoped to this option will also be removed. Continue?
editor.providerHelp: The package company is responsible for the overall package. The Services step describes what the program includes, such as transport, meals and guidance.
editor.stepHelp: Only a package name is needed for a draft. Program dates run from 8 April to 5 June 2027. Add stays, their periods, transport and room options. Nights are added across all periods of each stay.
editor.hotelDemoNote: These are fictional demo hotels. Choose a city first to see its hotels.
editor.periodsHelp: Up to 3 periods for the same hotel and housing type. All nights count toward cost; periods within one stay must not overlap.
editor.removePeriodsConfirm: The dates of the last periods will be removed. Continue?
editor.legacyTransportNote: Services from the previous model are retained for review, outside the new transport choices.
editor.bedTaxes: Taxes and fees on bed prices
editor.bedTaxesHelp: All rates apply to the same base price, without compounding, in every stay. A SAR 100 bed becomes SAR 125 per night. Profit is not added.
editor.bedNightPrice: Bed price per night before taxes and fees
editor.legacyCostNote: Saved cost using the previous basis; it has not been relabeled as a bed-night price.
editor.useBedNight: Enter a bed-night price instead of the previous cost

richText.heading: Heading
richText.hint: Write or paste Arabic and English descriptions with headings, paragraphs and lists. Maximum 20,000 characters.

editor.transportProvidersHint: Names come from active service providers categorized as Transport. Add the provider to that list if it is missing.
